question: Can PwD candidates get extra time or a scribe in JEE Advanced 2026?
expected_answer: Yes: one hour of compensatory time per paper and a scribe, by filling the required form at registration

According to the JEE Advanced 2026 Information Brochure, PwD candidates who are visually impaired, dyslexic (severe), have disability in the upper limbs, or have lost fingers/hands can avail the services of a scribe (amanuensis) [2]. Additionally, candidates with less than 40% disability and having difficulty in writing may also avail the services of a scribe [4]. They will also be given compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour of examination duration [8].

question: Which documents does a GEN-EWS candidate need for JEE Advanced 2026 registration?
expected_answer: GEN-EWS certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, or a declaration in lieu of the certificate (plus Class X and XII documents)
answer: A GEN-EWS candidate needs the following documents for JEE Advanced 2026 registration: 1. Class X certificate if the date of birth is mentioned in it OR birth certificate. 2. Class XII (or equivalent examination) certificate. 3. GEN-EWS certificate (FORM-GEN-EWS) issued on or after April 01, 2026. 4. If the candidate’s name is not same as in the Class X certificate, gazette notification showing the change of name. 5. If any GEN-EWS candidate fails or is unable to submit the GEN-EWS certificate at the time of online registration, the candidate has to upload a declaration (Declaration in Lieu of GEN-EWS Certificate) to that effect. [1]
